panels.title: The Discovery
panels.scene_description: Finn, a lively red fox, is crouched at the base of a massive ancient oak tree in a moonlit forest. His eyes are wide with wonder as he holds a glowing, crumpled map that emits a soft, golden light.
panels.narration: It started with a single, glowing scrap of parchment.
panels.caption: The map's glow illuminated the dark woods.
panels.image_prompt: A lively red fox crouched at the base of a large oak tree, holding a glowing crumpled map. Moonlit forest setting, soft golden glow from the map, wide-eyed expression, low angle shot, comic book style, adventurous mood, dynamic composition. No text or lettering in the art.

panels.title: The Hidden Path
panels.scene_description: Finn is captured mid-leap over a mossy log, following the glowing trail of the map. The map's light pulses brightly, illuminating a narrow, overgrown path surrounded by tall, shadowy trees that seem to close in.
panels.narration: The path was twisted and wild, but the map never wavered.
panels.caption: The map's light pulsated like a heartbeat.
panels.image_prompt: A red fox leaping over a mossy log in a narrow, shadowy forest path. Tall, dark trees looming over the scene, map glowing brightly in the fox's paws, dynamic mid-air action, dramatic lighting, comic book style, suspenseful mood, centered composition. No text or lettering in the art.

panels.title: The Hidden Garden
panels.scene_description: Finn stands at the edge of a lush, hidden garden filled with vibrant, bioluminescent flowers that mirror the map's glow. The moonlight filters through the canopy, casting a magical, serene light over the scene.
panels.narration: And there, hidden from the world, was the garden.
panels.caption: A sanctuary of light.
panels.image_prompt: A red fox standing at the edge of a lush, bioluminescent garden.
